mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, conditions are clear at Badger Prairie County Park under a third quarter moon.

Mayor Diaz has proclaimed October as Community Planning Month, honoring the expertise and dedication of our local planning staff. Additionally, residents are encouraged to learn about the free tri-shaw Bike program available at the Senior Center.

You can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market today or catch some live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the World Dairy Expo or the Farley Center Fall Festival.
In a report covering the end of September, on September 21, a retail theft occurred at a business on East Verona Avenue involving a subject stealing candy.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Really Reese's, and the shop opens today at 10:00 AM.
